parameters.jsCode:
const j=$json;
const prompt=[
  'Premium LinkedIn personal-brand editorial business poster background.',
  j.Visual_Scene+'.',
  j.Composition_Variant+'.',
  'Palette direction: '+j.Palette_Direction+'.',
  'Bright high-key natural daylight, airy polished atmosphere, professional but human.',
  'Egyptian or Middle Eastern SME context where relevant, realistic business environments, sophisticated consulting art direction.',
  'Create one unmistakable visual idea tied to the specific post, never a generic stock-photo meeting.',
  'Maximum two people. Natural anatomy, realistic hands and faces, credible proportions.',
  'Portrait-safe composition intended for a 4:5 poster crop: keep essential people and symbols inside the central 70 percent of the frame.',
  'Keep the upper quarter visually calm and relatively bright so Arabic headline typography can be overlaid later.',
  'Absolutely no visible words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI text or readable chart text anywhere in the generated image.',
  'Charts if present must be abstract unlabeled visual shapes only.',
  'No dark moody grading, no clutter, no neon, no sci-fi holograms, no repeated template composition.',
  'Photorealistic premium editorial finish with deliberate visual storytelling.'
].join(' ');
return [{json:{...j,Image_Prompt_Final:prompt}}];
